notes.title: Updated Version
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We have updated Conquer version with some bugs fixed, and also few things need attention:

1.	Sometimes one headset will lost on ground now should be fixed. 

2.	Unlock new weapon will be easier after you killing boss.

3.	For MR user, you have to make sure to keep your Blue Tooth in place where is no obstacle  between headset and Blue Tooth, otherwise it will cause unstable signal , your handset might be losing or dropping.

4.	If you find loading picture always pop up during the play, might have to set resolution to 120-150, above 150 resolution will kill frame rate dramatically unless you have 1080 video card.

notes.title: Updated Version
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We have updated Conquer version with some bugs fixed, and also few things need attention:

1.	Sometimes one headset will lost on ground now should be fixed. 

2.	Unlock new weapon will be easier after you killing boss.

3.	For MR user, you have to make sure to keep your Blue Tooth in place where is no obstacle  between headset and Blue Tooth, otherwise it will cause unstable signal , your handset might be losing or dropping.

4.	If you find loading picture always pop up during the play, might have to set resolution to 120-150, above 150 resolution will kill frame rate dramatically unless you have 1080 video card.
